checks.scope: PE x86/x64: verify instruction bytes and single-instruction lengths in submitted native listings, and compare indirect transfers and static IAT targets with calls.csv. Also check listing coverage against a bounded static walk from original PE roots. Verify declared direct internal edges and distinguish IAT references from control transfers. Function discovery, all possible instruction boundaries, arbitrary data references, source equivalence and runtime target sets are outside this check.
PE resource identities, code pages, RVAs and payloads, including exact bytes rebuilt from supported editable VERSIONINFO documents. Source-level use and UI behaviour are outside this check.
